info.title: vaultaffe
info.description: The HTTP surface of one vaultaffe instance, and the only way in or out of it (Specification §9). Every instance is at its own address. Everything but the handshake and the problem catalogue lives under /api/v1/, and every refusal is an application/problem+json document whose `code` names it.

get.summary: What this instance is and which versions of the contract it serves.
Every refusal this instance can make, by code.
What was changed, by whom, and of what kind. Never a value.
Whether this instance has been started, and what its organization is called.

post.summary: The first run: the default organization, and the first user as its administrator.
Email and password in, a session token out. The token is shown exactly once.

delete.summary: Revoke the session this request came in under.

get.summary: The caller: the organization, the person, and the token it came in under.

patch.summary: Change your own name — what the change log calls you.

get.summary: The people of this organization, oldest first, deactivated ones included.

post.summary: An administrator sets somebody's password, and ends their sessions.
An administrator changes the address somebody signs in with. Their sessions stay.
Take somebody out of the organization. Every token of theirs stops working.
Put them back. Their tokens work again, the revoked ones excepted.
Write out an invitation. Its link appears here and nowhere else, ever.

get.summary: Every invitation of this organization, newest first, in whatever state.

delete.summary: Take one back before anybody used it. The link stops working.

post.summary: What an invitation link is for. Unauthenticated: its holder has no identity yet.
Accept one: a password, and the session it signs you into.

get.summary: The organization this caller is in.

patch.summary: Rename it. The name is a team's own word for itself and nothing depends on it.

post.summary: Change the address you sign in with. Your sessions all stay.
Change your own password. Every other session of yours ends with it.
Begin a login: a short code for the human, a long one for the client.
Poll: the session token once a human has confirmed, a code that says why not until then.
Create a service or agent token. Its value appears here and nowhere else, ever.

get.summary: Every token of this organization, newest first, revoked ones included.

delete.summary: Revoke a token. Revoked rather than deleted, so its entries keep an author.

get.summary: Every project this token reaches. `deleted=true` lists the recoverable ones.

post.summary: Create a project, with dev, staging and prod unless others are named.

get.summary: One project by name, with the environments this token reaches.

delete.summary: Delete a project recoverably. Its environments are retained, not deleted.

post.summary: Bring a deleted project back inside its recovery window.
Remove a deleted project and its retained subtree, now. Human sessions only.
Remove a deleted environment and its secrets, now. Human sessions only.

get.summary: Every environment of a project. `deleted=true` lists the recoverable ones.

post.summary: Add an environment to a project. Freely nameable, and no privacy.
Bring a deleted environment back inside its recovery window.

get.summary: Every key and whether it is set, never a value. `deleted=true` lists the recoverable ones.
One value, by name. The only answer here that carries one.

put.summary: Write a value, or create an empty placeholder. The answer never echoes it.

post.summary: Bring a deleted secret back inside its recovery window.
Take a .env in, all of it or none of it. The answer names keys only.
Remove a deleted secret and everything it held, now. Human sessions only.

delete.summary: Remove what this secret used to hold, keeping it. Human sessions only.

get.summary: What this secret used to hold: when, and until when it is kept.
Every value of an environment as a .env. Human sessions only.
Keys most of this project's other environments have and this one has not. A line somebody silenced carries the moment they did; it is not left out.

post.summary: Stop the notice mentioning that key here. Nothing is created.

get.summary: Who has read this key, and when they first and last did. Never what.

post.summary: Put an earlier value back. A write like any other, and agents may.
